production_changes: Startup, request ACK and graceful shutdown retain their original deadlines but use only zero-time Win32 waits; existing timer/caller retries advance the lifecycle.

Each in-flight mailbox request retains operation, PID, thread, HWND, host Target intent, helper generation, sequence and original deadline. Competing targets can observe readiness but cannot overwrite or steal the owner result.
Cancelled or retargeted installs drain the original ACK and exact returned token Remove before resource release or a replacement request.

Host install can retain a valid pending subscription with Control.enabled=0 and an active 4ms timer; ACK success enables only current subscribers. Genuine failure preserves disabled state and starts a one-second completion-based retry.
Unused Targets that are still removing/retiring refuse new admission with ERROR_IO_PENDING. Quick off/on and PID reuse allocate fresh process handles and intents only after cleanup is confirmed.

Original exact-handle retirement, one-second termination retry throttle, private mailbox ownership and generation invalidation are preserved. Install/Remove remote failures retire uncertain hook state before freeing mappings.
No new worker thread or asynchronous pointer to Host/Target owner was introduced. The exact inheritable host-process handle remains the helper owner.

before_after.description: Identical supplied startup delay 2990ms and Install ACK delay 1990ms. Old production routes block one recovery pulse; new routes return pending and finish on subsequent calls.

api_contract.host_install: A nonzero subscription can still be connecting; keep its feature mapping and let Host pulse complete. A zero + ERROR_IO_PENDING has admitted no new lease and can release the current caller mapping before a short retry.
api_contract.deadline_policy: Consume an already-ready matching ACK before considering timeout. Timeout applies when the response is still unavailable at/after the original deadline. Cancelled and changed intents never publish the previous ACK.
api_contract.callers: Assist/Cursor and hook_diagnostics pending adapters are owned by the parent/other agents. The optional Windows fixture has bounded 4ms polling outside Host locks.

limits: Win32 process, event, mapping and hook-result boundaries are deterministic substitutes in the controlled tests; no actual Windows/game/multiplayer run was made by this agent.
Virtual 4980ms -> 0ms proves removal of explicit timeout waits from one pulse; it is not a measured wall-time or FPS improvement.
CreateProcess, mapping/handle APIs and TerminateProcess are still synchronous OS APIs. No absolute upper bound on their wall time is claimed.
Confirmed process exit is still required to close retained broker/mailbox ownership and admit a replacement. Kernel-level completion is not forced or assumed.
